title:
This type is created for ui components because we cannot add extra arguments to the rollupMetrics call from charts.
For example, to create a chart that uses the persisted rollupMetrics result for the `Organization` type,
there are two options:
1. In the chart configuration, set RollupMetricFromPersistedResult<Organization> as the data type.
2. Create type OrganizationRollupMetricFromPersistedResult mixes RollupMetricFromPersistedResult<Organization>,
set OrganizationRollupMetricFromPersistedResult as the data type in the chart.
name: RollupMetricFromPersistedResult
